newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 5.9 pct vs. year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 5.9 pct vs. year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 66,837 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended Dec 21, up 5.9 percent from the same period in 1995, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said.
The amount of weekly power supplied to the South Central region increased the most from a year ago, up 13.9 percent to 8,756 GWh, EEI said.
Year-to-date domestic power production totaled about 3.24 million GWh, up 2.4 percent from the same period in 1995, EEI said.
